messages:
Nadia H.: quick heads-up from the quarterly least-privilege audit: found 4 delegated-admin roles created during the vendor onboarding that still have AdminAccess attached. tagging @Luke W. who led the onboarding.
Luke W.: ah yikes, I remember we asked for elevated rights for the proof-of-concept. which roles exactly?
Nadia H.: listing: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/vendor-integration-admin, arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/vendor-logs-admin, arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/vendor-db-admin, arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/vendor-deploy-admin. lastUsed ranges 2025-09-10 -> 2026-01-04.
chris-sre: suggest immediate mitigation: detach AdminAccess, attach scoped policies (kms:Decrypt only where needed, s3:GetObject on specific prefixes, ec2:Describe* read-only). Do canary removal on vendor-integration-admin in us-west-2 first.
policy-bot: policy-review v3.2 -- flagged managed policy 'AdminAccess' attached to delegated roles. recommend least-priv template: vendor-integration-template-v1.
Nadia H.: also noticed some KMS key policies reference these role ARNs directly (for decrypt). need to update key policies to use aws:PrincipalArn condition or SourceAccount limitation before detaching to avoid breaking decrypt paths for other services.
Luke W.: confirmed vendor infra had a decryption step for log ingestion. we'll preserve kms:Decrypt for the specific key but scope to arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/vendor-logs-admin/* and add Condition StringEquals aws:SourceVpc or SourceAccount. I'll work with security to craft the key policy change.
chris-sre: plan: 1) snapshot current key policies and role tags, 2) create canary key-policy that adds principal restriction, 3) detach AdminAccess from canary role, 4) run ingress tests for log pipeline for 24h, 5) roll changes account-wide.
Nadia H.: filing SEC ticket SEC-8355 with evidence and remediation steps. attaching CloudTrail snippet for a representative Decrypt event.
Luke W.: pasted CloudTrail snippet into SEC-8355 and added vendor contact info. I'll also raise a change request for the vendor to rotate any long-lived creds and confirm they don't require broad account-level perms.
policy-bot: change-request created: CR-4821 referenced in SEC-8355.
sec-oncall-bot: Reminder: schedule 2h maintenance window for canary changes tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Nadia H.: one more ask: let's add an automated rule in entitlement-tracker to mark delegated roles created by third-party onboarding with an expiration tag (90d) and auto-notify owner. recurring problem.
chris-sre: +1. also adding an access-lint rule to flag roles with 'AdminAccess' attached and an external tag vendor=true.
policy-bot: rule-request logged: access-lint#2401 - 'vendor-admin-expiry' created by chris-sre.
Luke W.: thanks team, I'll coordinate with vendor and run the canary tomorrow. will post updates in this thread.
